hook.visual: Selfie close-up of a man in a blue zip top, puzzled squint; white-box text mid-frame 'THIS PRESS RELEASE DID WHAT?!' and 'GET ONE FREE!'.

beats.what: Puzzled face with a two-line title: the question plus a free giveaway
Cut to phone footage of his laptop: the press release report listing Google News, AP, ChatGPT, Yahoo, Bing
Back to face with a zoom punch: introduces himself and promises a free one at the end
Cut to the screen again: Google, ChatGPT logos and a list of local news outlets that picked it up
Back to face: says his agency does this monthly for clients to get AI visibility
Asks viewers to comment 'press release' to enter a draw for a free one
Zoom punch on the closing ask to follow

why_it_works: Question title plus 'GET ONE FREE!' in the first frame gives two reasons to stay: the result and the giveaway
Cuts to the real distribution report at 3 s, so proof (ChatGPT, Google News, AP logos) arrives before the explanation
Comment-a-keyword giveaway turns the CTA into an entry, which fits the high comment and share counts (33 comments, 51 shares)
weaknesses: Laptop screen filmed with a phone is skewed and hard to read on a small display
Very quiet audio (-29.0 LUFS) and no running captions after the opening title
Two stacked CTAs at the end (comment, then follow) dilute each other
for_robert: Cut to the proof screen within the first 3 s and offer a comment-keyword giveaway; record the screen properly instead of filming a laptop, and let Fred react to the result.
